ops.title: Stop repeating unchanged SSE record queries
ops.description: Owner /root/cci_grep_hotpath. Source-confirmed /v1/stream polls the same unmatched history every second because only delivered records advance its cursor. Preserve same-sequence Reparse and external SQL updates using a dedicated read-only SQLite data_version observer captured before queries; retain the delivered cursor and requery on each commit. No live DB access or lifecycle action during source work.

ops.text: Independent source review plus actual old-negative and current32/10000 idle-poll work bounds, same-seq mutation/lateappend/race/cancellation/output parity and required CI pass
Normal merge and signed public carrier preserve all current source and metadata
Official installation and affected SSE query measurement pass, with residual daemon CPU and protected legacy channels explicitly qualified
